newsitem.title: USA: Ecuadorian Minerals sets full Gaby study.
newsitem.headline: Ecuadorian Minerals sets full Gaby study.

text.p: Ecuadorian Minerals Corp said Tuesday it intends to proceed with a full feasibility study of the Gaby gold porphyry property in southern Ecuador by May and this would be completed in a year.
The prefeasibility study of the property is on schedule to be completed by March this year, the company said.

To date, process design criteria have been completed and a mineable reserve and capital cost estimate will be finalized by the end of January. Mine planning and economic analyses will be finished by the end of February and the final report issued in March, Ecuadorian Minerals said.
To date the company said, it has earned a controlling 55 percent interest in the northern portion of the main Gaby deposit, which represents the majority of the known deposit.

It said the remaining 45 percent interest in this northern portion can be earned by making further option payments over the next three years. The southern portion of the main Gaby deposit is governed by an agreement with Zappa Resources Ltd with Ecuadorian Minerals being the operator and having an option to acquire a 51 percent interest.

The company said it has granted an aggregate of 102,500 Incentive Share Options to employees pursuant to its Stock Option Plan at an exercise price of Cdn$0.86 per share until January 2007. The granting of these options is subject to regulatory approval.
